core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hamna is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Soft, tender, sweet fruit”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hamna corresponds to the Arabic form حمنة (Arabic حَمْنَة (Ḥamna)). Its core sense is a desert plant, a herb. Hamna is Arabic حَمْنَة (Ḥamna), the name of a desert plant, used as a feminine personal name — notably by Ḥamna bint Jaḥsh, a documented early Islamic woman. The source gloss 'soft, tender, sweet fruit' is unsupported; the lexical sense is the plant name. Recorded at medium confidence because the botanical identification of حمنة varies between lexicographers.

persian.name: حمنه
